value.text: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
value.author: Kent Beck

steps.label: nothing is loaded, and the session header the app sends is its own slot
signing in writes the slot the app-level header is built from
the first two attempts fail with 5xx, so the app is still loading rather than failed
after the exponential backoff (200ms, then 400ms) the third attempt succeeds — one wait, not one step per tick; the window is generous because what is asserted is the ladder, not the machine's timing

domIncludes: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
